source_caption_data.pre_caption: The video starts with a medium shot, framing a character in a blue vest from behind in the left foreground, who is squatting on stone steps and holding another person in red. To their right, in the middle ground, a person in a green dress lies on the wooden floor. A large stone pillar is in the immediate foreground on the far left, a wall sconce is in the top right middle ground, and a cabinet is in the left background. The camera, positioned at the subjects' level, slowly pulls back and pans slightly right, transitioning to a medium full shot of the characters in the bottom left and a wider view of the room. A watermark is fixed in the bottom right corner.
